# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering fixes** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.157.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with fixes for rasterization, text, image filtering and GPU rendering. The stable release adds mask-filtered glyph corrections and tighter image-subset sampling to the fixes delivered in previews. Generated LibraryImport bindings now explicitly use cdecl, including in HarfBuzzSharp.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment targets** — The native Graphite Metal backend now requires iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If using this backend, raise older deployment targets accordingly. These native minimums do not lower any higher requirements imposed by managed packages or frameworks. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 157** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer path and glyph rasterization** — Fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and convex-path bounds. Validates direct-mask glyph replay and corrects mask-filtered glyph reloads, incompatible mask copies and clipped embossed-glyph planes. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
- **Correct GPU geometry and text** — Corrects reflected zero-length hairline square caps, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, text-atlas selection and stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **More reliable image filtering** — Prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from leaking into image subsets under minification, skew, anti-aliased clipping and MSAA. Aligns displacement-offset precision with filter bounds and image-filter cache equality with hashing. ([#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710), [#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Graphite clipping and readback** — Fixes clip-key packing, wedge inflation and alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback stride. Clip draws now count toward render-pass capacity; a draw whose full clip stack cannot fit is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding capacity. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Vulkan synchronization and cleanup** — Fixes render-pass pointer initialization and adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 through 55. Native synchronous submission now accounts for fence-wait failures; managed GRContext.Submit remains void and exposes no new failure result. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now match the cdecl convention used by DllImport and delegates, addressing a calling-convention mismatch relevant to Windows x86. Runtime validation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

Generated HarfBuzzSharp LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths without changing public APIs or native exports.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed Ganesh geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. It also improved displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling without adding a managed submission result.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also added a device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite clipping and readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport bindings. Graphite Metal adopted the native iOS/tvOS 15 minimum; HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
